statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-11940: tarfile extraction with the 'data' or 'tar' filter could be bypassed by a hard link that refers to a symbolic link stored at a deeper name; the extraction fallback checked the symlink at its archived location but recreated it at the hard link's shallower path, so a relative target judged contained could escape the destination. Upstream issue: https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/151558 and advisory: https://mail.python.org/archives/list/security-announce@python.org/thread/LD6QIISNQFQYOIEPJNEUIPV7S3V76FZH/. The fix on the 3.10 branch is commit https://github.com/python/cpython/commit/0f852b3f07dd8e71e40326a51c02afbf16a42cc5, a backport of gh-151558 first released in Python 3.10.21, which makes makelink_with_filter() in Lib/tarfile.py also run the extraction filter on the link with the hard link's own name before using the fallback; its other changes are a test and a NEWS entry. Checked usr/lib/python3.10/tarfile.py in the python-3.10 package. The python-3.10-pycache-pyc0, -pyc1 and -pyc2 packages of each build carry tarfile .pyc files compiled with checked source hashes, and in every build their hash matches that build's tarfile.py, so Python revalidates them against that source at import, in every build of the python-3.10 source published in the DHI Alpine 3.23 repository, 3.10.19-r0 to 3.10.22-r8, x86_64 and aarch64, checksums verified against the repository index. The added filter call is absent in every build before 3.10.20-r10 and present in 3.10.20-r10 and every later build, on both architectures: 3.10.20-r10 is a DHI backport of that change onto 3.10.20, and the 3.10.21 and 3.10.22 builds carry the upstream fix. The range ends at 3.10.20-r10, the first published build with the fix.

tarfile's 'data' and 'tar' extraction filters could be bypassed by a hardlink that references a symlink stored at a deeper path: the fallback validated the symlink at its archived location but recreated it at the hardlink's path, so its target could point outside the destination (an incomplete fix of CVE-2025-4330). Upstream fixed it in https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/151558 with commit be13e86 on the 3.11 branch, which makes makelink_with_filter() in Lib/tarfile.py also run the extraction filter on the link member under the hardlink's own name: https://github.com/python/cpython/commit/be13e86f6b9788a6f4d0419dffef72cbae5865c9 and first released it in CPython 3.11.16. The advisory is https://mail.python.org/archives/list/security-announce@python.org/thread/LD6QIISNQFQYOIEPJNEUIPV7S3V76FZH/ and the CVE record is https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-11940. The DHI python-3.11 packages for Alpine 3.23 carry a backport of that fix from 3.11.15-r10, made before the upstream 3.11.16 release. We checked every package built from source python-3.11 except python-3.11-doc and python-3.11-tests, in every published build for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository: 24 builds, 3.11.14-r0 to the current 3.11.18-r4, on x86_64 and aarch64, each against its index checksum. The python-3.11 package ships the module as /usr/lib/python3.11/tarfile.py. It has the extra extraction-filter call that the fix adds to makelink_with_filter() in 3.11.15-r10 and every later build, and lacks it in 3.11.14-r0 to 3.11.15-r9. The tarfile .pyc files in the python-3.11-pycache-pyc0, -pyc1 and -pyc2 packages are checked-hash .pyc files, and the source hash they record changes exactly where the tarfile.py source changes.

CVE-2026-11940: tarfile.extractall() with the 'data' or 'tar' filter could be bypassed by a hard link that references a symlink stored at a deeper name, letting files be written outside the destination. Upstream fixed it in https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/151558 (3.12 commit https://github.com/python/cpython/commit/e5fdbd8d5aa923bd9111b112ea73bd6ec7c47877), first released in CPython 3.12.14; see https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-11940. Checked Lib/tarfile.py for the hard-link fallback that re-filters the target under the link's own name in the python-3.12 package of every build published in the DHI Alpine 3.23 repository, 3.12.12-r0 to 3.12.16-r4, x86_64 and aarch64; both architectures agree. Builds before 3.12.13-r10 lack the fix; 3.12.13-r10 and every later build have it. The range ends at 3.12.13-r10.
